events.summary: Customers can connect M365 Copilot with Adobe Experience Manager Assets to retrieve marketing and creative assets with Copilot Connector.

events.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Extensibility] Users can create agents scoped on Custom connector containers
events.titleJa: Microsoft 365 Copilot の連携機能を拡張
events.titleEn: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Extensibility] Users can create agents scoped on Custom connector containers
events.summary: 1. Makers can now scope their data in their agent created on custom connector data at a particular container. 2. These containers will be defined during creation/updating of the custom connector.
events.summaryJa: 1. メーカーは、特定のコンテナーのカスタム コネクタ データに基づいて作成されたエージェント内のデータをスコープできるようになりました。 2. これらのコンテナは、カスタム コネクタの作成/更新中に定義されます。
events.summaryEn: 1. Makers can now scope their data in their agent created on custom connector data at a particular container. 2. These containers will be defined during creation/updating of the custom connector.
